integrity: Exact symbolic formulas and an explicit proof are provided; standalone finite checks cover n up to 6 and are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Formula applies to distinct embedded one-generated inverse submonoids in the finite symmetric inverse monoid with the global identity retained; not to arbitrary inverse subsemigroups or abstract isomorphism classes. Independent audit is not performed; equivalent earlier embedded enumerations under another vocabulary remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Embedded monogenic inverse submonoids of finite symmetric inverse monoids
